description: This file defines the Store class, part of the Opencart Admin Model for handling store-related operations such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving store information, as well as counting stores based on various filters.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: The Store class manages CRUD operations for store entities and provides statistical data about stores, including counts based on various filters such as layout, language, currency, country, and more.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Adds a new store record to the database, sets up associated layouts and SEO URLs, clears relevant cache, and returns the new store ID.

methods.name: editStore
methods.description: Updates the store information, clears the cache, and handles associated deletions in related tables such as layouts, SEO URLs, settings, and other store-specific data.

methods.name: deleteStore
methods.description: Deletes a store and all related data including layouts, categories, products, and GDPR entries associated with the store.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a store specified by its store ID.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Fetches a list of all stores, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: createStoreInstance
methods.description: Creates and initializes a store-specific registry with configuration, language, URL, session, and other components.

methods.name: getTotalStores
methods.description: Returns the total number of stores.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the count of stores associated with a specific layout ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLanguage
methods.description: Returns the count of stores configured with a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCurrency
methods.description: Returns the count of stores configured with a specific currency.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCountryId
methods.description: Returns the count of stores in a specific country.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the number of stores linked to a particular layout ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLanguage
methods.description: Returns total stores filtered by language.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCountryId
methods.description: Counts stores filtered by country ID.
